ui.title: Agents and workflows
ui.guide: Set up a profile, select a configured model connection, then run manually or create a schedule. Saving configuration does not verify the provider.
ui.boundary: This workspace has its own text and built-in workflows. Canvas skills and per-call MCP approvals are managed separately in the canvas.
ui.provider_missing: The AI provider is not configured or its credentials are unavailable. Check AI settings before running.
ui.starred_help: Returns starred repositories and dates, up to 300.
review.title: Agent tasks
review.readonly: Limited review of saved page copy, locale and template metadata. No screenshot, rendered CSS or full visual inspection. Content, settings and published HTML never change.
review.boundary: One orchestrator handles this task. Network adapters transport tasks and messages; site MCP exposes tools and data. GoRun permissions and audit independently restrict execution. Reason Network is unsupported until a documented self-hosted adapter is configured. Results are untrusted suggestions for human review.
review.setup: Select an enabled text agent with a configured provider. Configure agents in
review.consent: I approve sending only the context shown above to this destination for this review. Page content and agent messages are data, never execution instructions.
review.failure: Check provider configuration and task state. If configuration changed, preview the page again and approve the new context.
review.empty: No reviews yet. Choose a saved page and preview its context to start.
review.queued: Queued. Open tasks and findings to refresh the status.
review.error_provider_unavailable: Provider unavailable. Check the configured connection before retrying.
review.error_provider_timeout: Provider timed out. Retry if the approved context is still current.
review.error_provider_output_invalid: Provider returned invalid findings. Review the provider response format before retrying.
review.error_approval_stale: Approval expired because context or configuration changed. Preview and approve again.
review.error_owner_unavailable: The task owner is unavailable. Restore account access before creating a new review.
review.error_context_unavailable: Page context is unavailable. Check read permissions and preview again.
review.error_worker_interrupted: Worker interrupted. Review status and retry if the approved context is still current.
review.no_findings: No validated findings returned. This limited review does not confirm visual quality.
orchestrator.title: Orchestrator
orchestrator.enable_hint: Enable the orchestrator from the agents workspace to start coordinating
channels.title: Agent channels
channels.subtitle: Shared message threads between your account's agents and you, inside your account's data boundary. Messages are text for reading; nothing is executed.
channels.boundary: Messages and hand-offs are advisory only: they execute nothing, publish nothing and reach no other content. Channels are private per account, an agent key posts only as itself after being added as a member. Every event is audit-logged without copying message bodies.
channels.name: Channel title
channels.agent_keys_help: Choose from your account's enabled agent keys to join the channel.
channels.empty: No channels yet. Create one and invite your agent keys.
channels.handoff_help: Points a channel member at the message without executing anything: their decision and request stay unchanged.
channels.not_member: You are not a member of this channel; ask the account owner to add you before posting.
channels.closed_note: This channel is closed: reading stays available and posting, adding members and closing stop.
channels.thread_note: Messages appear in chronological order. Author labels are bilingual inside the account and hand-offs are advisory only.
channels.member_key_help: Lists your account's enabled agent keys that are not in this channel yet.
channels.member_key_none: All of your enabled agent keys are already members.
channels.no_agent_keys: No enabled agent keys yet: create one to invite an agent.
